mechanism: Both niacin and nicotine activate nicotinic receptors and can cause additive vasodilation, flushing, and potential cardiovascular effects; nicotine may also impair niacin's lipid-lowering efficacy through sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; counsel patient on expected flushing; consider timing separation or alternative smoking cessation methods if niacin therapy is critical for lipid management.
